prohibited_conclusions: Not medical, skin-interface stress, or product ground truth
Not kPa; pressure values are raw PMarray response semantics
TRAIN/VAL results are NOT final TEST or Full experiment conclusions
Joint-geometry baseline is NOT implemented in B02 v0.1 (insufficient input contract)

baselines.name: all_background
baselines.description: Every pixel is BACKGROUND.  Metric sanity floor only; never a candidate.

baselines.name: train_spatial_prior
baselines.description: Per-pixel class probability template fitted on TRAIN labels; frozen before VAL evaluation; argmax at predict time.  Pressure is NOT used as input.

baselines.name: pressure_body_axis_partition
baselines.description: Body axis + longitudinal partition built only from pressure (contact mask, centroid, PCA, segment fractions).  No region label input.  All ratios and thresholds are versioned config; any TRAIN-derived quantity is recorded as fit_split=train.

baselines.name: pressure_axis_contact_intersection
baselines.description: Intersect frozen train_spatial_prior template with pressure contact evidence; deterministic conflict resolution via region_priority.  Empty contact or degenerate PCA falls back to template.

inputs_forbidden_as_predictor_input: A08 joints / body geometry (independent alignment contract not yet approved)

not_implemented.reason: B01 freeze does not provide joint features as a predictor input.  A08 body-geometry features require an independent, approved data alignment contract that is not part of B01; this baseline is OUT OF SCOPE for B02 v0.1.
